title: Style Guide: Federation Bathrooms
bodyHtml:
The Traditional Bathroom Style Edit

Federation style bathrooms, often referred to as "Traditional" or "Period Style," have a timeless charm that continues to captivate homeowners across Australia. Bursting with nostalgia and classic elegance, it's no wonder that this design choice remains a popular one.

We’re excited to share our Federation Bathroom Style Guide, crafted to help you recreate the sophistication of this classic era with ease. Read on to learn more about how to bring that timeless look to your bathroom:

The Federation Basin/Sink

Selecting the right basin type is critical to the wash area as it is essentially the centrepiece for your everyday rituals. There are a few options to go with here, but period style bathrooms work best with Inset basins, Under Counter basins, Consoles or Pedestals.

Explore Collection Federation

Complete the Look - Federation Toilets

Federation style toilets are now available with the technology of today's era, and can be found in most configurations such as the back-to-wall suite, wall faced pan or even wall hung variations.

Besides aesthetic, look for a toilet with quality flushing internal components. To really step it up, consider pairing your toilet with a traditional style bidette!

Complete the Look - Federation Style Bath

A Federation-style bathroom really isn’t complete without a traditional freestanding bath. Available in various materials and finishes, you can make a bold statement by selecting a bath with true to period details and aesthetics.

The Impero Bath

Complete the Look - Tapware & Accessories

Consistency in style and finish is key. While chrome is a classic choice, don't hesitate to experiment with warmer metallics like brass and copper, or textured finishes like brushed nickel or satin chrome.

Federation Design Elements

Wood Panelling and Pine Moulding

Add instant charm to your bathroom with wall panels or pine moulding. These accents bring period-era finesse to plain walls and are a cost-effective way to enhance the traditional aesthetic.

Impero Suite

Patterned Tiles

Classic black and white chequered tiles are always a safe bet, but consider stepping outside the box with ornamental patterned floor tiles that are making a comeback.

Bold Wall Paper

Create a stunning feature wall with traditional wallpaper. Opt for bathroom-suitable wallpapers with waterproof qualities, and choose designs that feature botanical imagery or Edwardian patterns for an eye-catching focal point.
